liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Visions Of Johanna** (3 reviews): The reviewer states that this song was always stunning; Listed as a highlight, alongside Playing In The Band and Drums [27][34][35]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): The reviewer calls this performance an unsung hero of the 1980s [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-03-19.140272.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 148 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: PA mix and sound issues plagued much of the first set [1]
- **gd1986-03-19.151705.Mouth.AKG.Master.Cassette.Mance.Rogers.Noel.t-flac2496**: source not stated; 21 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1986-03-19.132686.naks.datbrad.lynn.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 143 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1986-03-19.151949.Mouth.AKG.Master.Cassette.Mance.Rogers.Noel.t-flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 147 min [6]
- **gd1986-03-19.senn.441.me80.buyers.118517.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 139 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as really crisp, with Phil sounding great [31]
- **gd1986-03-19.s1.sbd.barletta-sirmick.109882.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 70 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [24]. Said about its sound: Major PA problems occurred during this song and Stagger Lee; Audio quality improves during this song, though the board sounds off [29]

## Around the show

- The reviewer attended their first show, staying until 3:20 AM before leaving [28]
- Bob's microphone failed, causing irritation until he kicked over the stand [30]
- This was the first performance of the song [3]
- This was the first performance of the song [6]
- The return to this song is on par with the '89 Dark Star [33]
- Spring 86 had great east coast shows, and this is one of them [36]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-03-19.140272.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Charlie Miller, Jim Wise, Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 > Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown deck/hardware/software) > hard disk > Adobe Audition… [1]
- **gd1986-03-19.151705.Mouth.AKG.Master.Cassette.Mance.Rogers.Noel.t-flac2496**: taped by Kenny Mance; transferred by Transfer by Craig Rogers Edited & Mastered (Adobe Audition) by Joe Noel February 02, 2021; source: Source: (Mouth) AKG CE1s > Uher CR240 > Master Cassettes [3]
- **gd1986-03-19.132686.naks.datbrad.lynn.flac16**: taped by datbrad; transferred by mark lynn; source: OTS 2 Nakamichi CM100s/cP4 shotguns(PAS)>Sony TCD5M (Fuji Metal); [4]. Also: A small patch with an unknown source bridges the tape flip near Wheel [4]
- **gd1986-03-19.151949.Mouth.AKG.Master.Cassette.Mance.Rogers.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Recording by Kenny Mance; transferred by Transfer by Craig Rogers Edited & Mastered (Adobe Audition) by Joe Noel February 02, 2021; source: Source: (Mouth) AKG CE1s > Uher CR240 > Master Cassettes [6]
- **gd1986-03-19.senn.441.me80.buyers.118517.flac16**: taped by Mike Buyers; transferred by Lenny Stubbe; source: Sennheiser 441 + Sennheiser ME80-> 4 channel mic preamp/mixer, (mixer unknown)-> analog stereo out-> Technics RS-B68R home deck; Config/Location: ORTF behind… [7]
